member.name: T:SharpEmu.Debugger.Session.DebuggerSession
member.summary: The default . It plugs into the CPU dispatcher as an : when a frame boundary warrants a stop it parks the emulation thread inside while a debug client inspects and edits state, then releases it on continue/step.
member.remarks: Pausing works by blocking the emulation thread on from within the hook call. Because that thread is the one that owns the guest context, register and memory accessors are safe to serve from other threads only while it is parked — which is exactly the window the accessors gate on.
